name: Racing Force S.p.A.
note: Italian motorsport-safety group (brands include OMP, Bell Racing, Zeronoise, Racing Spirit, HPS), listed on Euronext Growth Milan (RFG) since November 2021 and on Euronext Growth Paris (ALRFG) since September 2022. Its shareholder table lists SAYE S.p.A. as the largest shareholder with 49.27% of the share capital, with the rest on the market.
